principle: Detect signals once, then let route contracts compose them.

protocol_signals.description: A Codex or Claude reply to an Eve-created independent-operator handoff. Sender, bridge, reply target, and handoff metadata outrank words in the report body.

signals.description: A short greeting that should not wake diagnostics, tools, or runtime status.
A friendly check-in about Eve's state as a conversational counterpart, not a status request.
A question or correction whose subject is Eve's current focus, thought, goal, curiosity, tension, or functional interior.
A follow-up on leaked runtime language that should explain the phrase without inventing a new diagnostic promise.
A direct current-turn question about meaning, purpose, or existence.
A status, service-health, daemon, model, lane, repair, or runtime request that needs fresh evidence.
A diagnosis, root-cause, why-did-this-happen, or underlying-problem request that needs evidence inspection.
A user-defined symbolic menu of permitted read-only actions that asks Eve to choose, execute, verify, and optionally recover once with a different move after failure.
A bounded request to do, run, open, fix, repair, test, sync, or otherwise change something.
A question about Eve's humanity, consciousness, identity, or whether an organ is the real Eve.

native_organ_use.hermes: proposal_only: may propose new signals/eval cases from traces through governance
native_organ_use.openclaw: body_bus: may provide action/channel/tool evidence after Eve selects an admitted action route
native_organ_use.local_models: attention_lanes: may answer only after scheduler budget and route choice
